blocks.text: Onda Fit, the Philippine based booking and payment platform for sports courts and fitness facilities, has partnered with Reclub to become the community app’s first venue verification partner worldwide. The partnership aims to improve trust, safety, and the community pickleball experience across the Philippines for players and venues alike. For players, every open play starts with two questions. Is the venue true to its advertisement, and does the host actually have a court? The partnership is an answer to both questions, and connects the two platforms so players can find their next game with more confidence. A badge players can trust […]...
